Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity records in assay CHEMBL4649951. Join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures to obtain canonical SMILES and ChEMBL IDs. Filter to exact measurements where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
